summary: The note describes Đakovo Cathedral, also called the Cathedral Basilica of St. Peter, which serves as the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Đakovo-Osijek in Đakovo, Croatia. It is presented as the largest sacral newly built structure of Croatian historicism and the town's most famous landmark and most important sacred object. The note is brief and gives no construction dates or architectural details.
one_line: Đakovo Cathedral (Cathedral Basilica of St. Peter) is the seat of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Đakovo-Osijek in Croatia and a major historicist landmark.
key_facts: Đakovo Cathedral is also known as the Cathedral basilica of St. Peter.
Đakovo Cathedral is the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Đakovo-Osijek.
Đakovo Cathedral is located in Đakovo, Croatia.
Đakovo Cathedral is the biggest sacral newly built building of Croatian historicism.
The St. Peter Cathedral in Đakovo is the town's most famous landmark.
The St. Peter Cathedral in Đakovo is the most important sacral object in the town.
